patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, high-resolution lifestyle photography and video as dominant section backgrounds, often with minimal text overlays, creating an immersive, editorial feel.

A clear typographic hierarchy with large, bold sans-serif headings for primary statements, complemented by smaller, lighter-weight body text and uppercase, slightly tracked-out labels for categories and secondary information.
A high-contrast black and white base palette, with vibrant accent colors (red for sales, green for CTAs) and natural tones from lifestyle imagery providing visual interest.

The hero section features a subtle parallax effect where the background image shifts slower than the foreground text as the user scrolls, creating a sense of depth. The top navigation bar transforms from a transparent state to an opaque black, slightly shorter sticky bar with white text upon scrolling.
Sections are primarily delineated by full-bleed image or video backgrounds, often with text overlays, interspersed with clean, grid-based product displays and promotional banners.

technique_notes: The site uses full-bleed, high-resolution lifestyle photography and video as background elements for major sections, often applying a subtle dark gradient or overlay to ensure text readability without obscuring the imagery. Text is positioned strategically to interact with the visual composition.

A sticky header is implemented that dynamically changes its visual properties (background color, height, text color) as the user scrolls past the initial hero content, providing a compact and persistent navigation experience. The hero section itself utilizes a subtle parallax scrolling effect, where the background image moves at a slightly different rate than the foreground content, enhancing visual depth and engagement.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body text) create strong visual impact, complemented by smaller, lighter-weight body text and uppercase, slightly tracked-out labels for a clean, modern feel.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are used consistently throughout the design for images, buttons, and containers, reinforcing a clean and modern aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced spacing is used for content blocks and product grids, with generous vertical padding around full-bleed image sections to create an airy, editorial feel and emphasize visual content.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its heavy reliance on high-quality, full-bleed lifestyle photography and video, which transforms the browsing experience into an immersive, editorial magazine-like journey rather than a typical e-commerce product catalog. This visual-first approach, combined with subtle motion and a clean layout, creates a premium and aspirational brand presence.
